record.title: MEASURE run control — R3
record.body: R3 MEASURE started from exact Project #2 snapshot PVT_kwHOCCCFfc4BhZKe with 368 items. Consumed frontier, ledger, measure, portfolio and phase-change query memories. Initial frontier size=5; weakest multiplier=independent qualified consumer breadth. Candidate repositories: ggen-marketplace, ggen, chatgpt-cloud-elixir, ex4pm, gymact. Primary hypothesis: convert the already-manufactured consumer qualification/court machinery into scalable independently receipted consumer execution and receipt-assimilation topology rather than another producer-local sensor family.
